scripts.dev:web: bash scripts/with-local-env.sh npm --prefix apps/web run dev
scripts.dev:agent: bash scripts/with-local-env.sh sh -c 'cd services/agent && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000'
scripts.test:agent: bash scripts/with-local-env.sh sh -c 'cd services/agent && uv run pytest'
scripts.db:reset: supabase db reset && npm run bootstrap
scripts.bootstrap: bash scripts/with-local-env.sh sh -c 'cd services/agent && uv run python scripts/bootstrap_accounts.py && uv run python scripts/bootstrap_forms.py'
scripts.types: supabase gen types typescript --local > apps/web/src/lib/database.types.ts && npx --yes oxfmt apps/web/src/lib/database.types.ts
